entities.summary: Andrew Heiskell was chairman and CEO of Time Inc. (1960–1980), and also known for his philanthropy, for organizations including the New York Public Library, the revitalization of New York's Bryant Park, the Urban Coalition, Enterprise Foundation, and the American Academy in Rome. He cofounded People for the American Way and was president of the Inter American Press Association (1961–1962) and president of the Harvard University Board of Overseers.
